description: This walk runs from St Aubin to St Brelade Bay on the southern side of Jersey. It's about a 4km walk first heading south and then west to Ouaisne Beach before following the Jersey Coast Path talong St Brelade Bay. Starting in the charming harbour of St Aubin, you will climb away from the bustling quayside and find yourself immersed in lush coastal greenery. The path offers sweeping views across the English Channel as you round the headland toward the pristine dunes of Ouaisne Common. As the terrain transitions from sheltered woodland trails to soft sand, you will eventually reach the promenade of St Brelade’s Bay, famous for its golden shoreline and the historic Fisherman's Chapel tucked at the water's edge
